text:
Maria: Heads-up — we started getting a spike of 503s for hosted inference in us-west-2 at 2025-11-05T16:03Z. CS is seeing timeouts and a couple of customers reported failed requests.
ops-bot: alert posted: hosted-api / 5xx surge (count=312, p95 latency 1.8s)
Ryan: Looking at infra logs now. I can see worker containers on gpu-pool-3 are restarting repeatedly. Docker events show OOM kills followed by container restart.
Anika: Any recent runtime or model deploys? Which model and what were the incoming batch sizes?
Maria: Model: open-llama-13b-ql8 (recent quant swap deployed ~10:58). CS noticed a burst of large embed batches from a single customer (batch_size ~64, many short prompts). Repro curl I used below.
Maria: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"open-llama-13b-ql8","inputs":["...repeat 64 short prompts..."]}'
```
Jamal: Kernel logs show both OOM killer lines and a SIGSEGV in the inference runner: 
```
[ 102.345678] Out of memory: Killed process 4521 (infer-runner) total-vm:134217728kB, anon-rss:123456kB
infer-runner[4521]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f3d... libtorch.so+0x12f45
```
Ryan: That stack smells like kv-cache or attention kernel memory growth under the quant profile. I'm also seeing increases in resident set before the kill.
Anika: We rolled a kernel selector tweak for ql8 earlier today that changes per-token buffer allocation. I suspect an edge case with batching + prefix caching.
Maria: CS wants a quick mitigation and clear repro steps to pass to the customer.
Ryan: Short-term mitigation: add fallback routing for requests hitting gpu-pool-3 to a compatible ql4 variant (open-llama-13b-ql4) and disable the new kernel selector on the canary hosts. Also throttle max batch size to 32 for the affected pool.
Jamal: I've pushed a temporary autoscaler policy to prevent dense packing on those nodes (avoid packing > 32 embed items). Also saved a heap snapshot and the coredump to s3: s3://redwood-debug/7123456789/heap-4521.tar.gz and uploaded container logs to the incident bucket.
Anika: I'll open a quick revert for the kernel selector change and run canary redeploy with extra memlimits. If that looks stable, we'll roll to the fleet. Assigning the PR to me and Jamal. ETA ~45m.
Maria: I'll update CS and the customers. Can you add a short reproducible script for QA? We should include the curl above and a small python that simulates 64 parallel embed requests.
Anika: Adding repro script to the PR and QA job. Note: reproducible only under heavy batch-density; local single-request tests won't trigger it.
Maria: Thanks. Mitigation applied and customers notified. Will follow up with postmortem if impact window > 10m. :thumbsup:
Jamal: Adding runbook note: if we see segfault+oom pattern again, immediately route traffic off pool and collect full /proc/<pid>/maps + nvml logs.
Maria: Closing loop here, tracking follow-ups in ticket INF-2147.
